title: Score and align a word with an HMM
brief: Compute Gaussian emission log-likelihoods, score a sequence with the forward algorithm in log space, and align it with Viterbi.
hints: Broadcast X[:, None, :] against means[None, :, :] to get a (T, N, D) array, then sum over the last axis.
In forward, log_alpha[t - 1][:, None] + log_A has shape (N, N) with rows as 'from' states; logsumexp over axis=0 sums over where you came from.
In viterbi, store psi[t] = argmax over axis 0 of delta[:, None] + log_A, then walk back with path[t - 1] = psi[t, path[t]].
A log probability of -inf is fine: logsumexp and argmax both handle it, so you need no special case for a forbidden transition.
